class.name: WindReceiver3D
class.description: Add it as a child of a [RigidBody3D] (or a [VehicleBody3D]) to push the body with the wind. Every physics tick it applies aerodynamic drag, [code]0.5 * air density * drag_coefficient * area * speed²[/code], along the wind relative to the body, so a body moving with the wind feels no force. The force acts at this node's position. Place it above the body's center to make tall objects tip over, or at the center to only push them. Without an [member area], the area facing the wind is worked out from the body's [CollisionShape3D] children and the body's rotation: a plank broadside to the wind catches more of it than end-on. Under a parent that is not a [RigidBody3D], it only computes the force; read it with [method get_wind_force], for example to push a [CharacterBody3D] from a script.

method.name: get_effective_area
method.description: The area facing the current wind, in square meters: [member area], or the one worked out from the collision shapes.

method.name: get_wind_force
method.description: The drag force of the last physics tick, in newtons.

method.name: get_wind_velocity
method.description: The wind at this node in the last physics tick, in meters per second.

method.name: update_shape_size
method.description: Measures the parent's collision shapes again. Call it after changing them; it happens by itself when the node enters the tree.

members.member: Area facing the wind in square meters. [code]0.0[/code] works it out from the parent's collision shapes.
Drag coefficient of the body's shape: about [code]0.5[/code] for a sphere, [code]1.0[/code] for a cube, [code]1.2[/code] for a flat plate face-on.
If [code]false[/code], the wind doesn't push the body.
Multiplier for the force, to exaggerate or soften the wind on this body.
A sleeping body is only woken when the wind would accelerate it by more than this, in m/s². Keeps resting bodies asleep in a light breeze.
